settings.heading: Custom Design
settings.text:
Custom design starts with a conversation. Tell us what you have in mind — a piece you've pictured, stones you'd like to use, or jewellery you'd like remodelled — and we'll help shape it into a design that's beautiful to look at and practical to wear every day.

We'll talk you through the options, stones and metals in plain English, and give you a clear quote and timeframe before anything is made.

settings.heading: Tell us what you have in mind
settings.text: Give us a brief of what you envision — the piece, the stones, any jewellery you'd like to remodel — and we'll be in touch to arrange a time to talk it through. Or visit us in store to get started.
